name: Grok
summary: xAI's AI assistant with real-time web and X search.
description: Grok is xAI's AI assistant for chat, voice, image and video creation, coding and real-time answers drawn from the web and X. It differentiates itself through live X integration and a single subscription that bundles Grok Chat, Imagine, Build, the Grok API, Cursor access and X benefits. Plans start with Plus at $8/month ($7/month billed annually); Premium is $30/month and higher Super and Ultra tiers add more usage. The plans page lists no $0 tier.
